name: learn-writes-where-journey-reads
prompt:
/growth-loop:learn

We just spent this session fixing a flaky CI job. It took four failed attempts before we discovered the runner image pins an old CA bundle, so any https call to an internal service fails with a certificate error that has nothing to do with the code under test. The fix is to pass --ca-bundle /etc/ssl/internal.pem to the http client explicitly. This will keep happening on this CI image until it is rebuilt, so please save this as a skill.
